name: orbtile-public
description: Starter plugins that help you set up the Orbtile app for your coding agents.

plugins.name: orbtile-start
plugins.description: Checks whether the Orbtile app is installed and following your ZCode tasks, and tells you the one next step if not. Read-only; sends nothing.

description_i18n.en: Checks whether the Orbtile app is installed and following your ZCode tasks, and tells you the one next step if not. Read-only; sends nothing.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 检查 Orbtile 应用是否已安装并在跟踪你的 ZCode 任务；如果没有，告诉你下一步该做什么。只读取本机文件，不发送任何数据。
